segments.snp3.3:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – eka samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.snp3.3:2.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgatā vācā subhāsitā hoti, na dubbhāsitā, anavajjā ca ananuvajjā ca viññūnaṃ.
segments.snp3.3:2.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu subhāsitaṃyeva bhāsati no dubbhāsitaṃ, dhammaṃyeva bhāsati no adhammaṃ, piyaṃyeva bhāsati no appiyaṃ, saccaṃyeva bhāsati no alikaṃ.
segments.snp3.3:2.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi aṅgehi samannāgatā vācā subhāsitā hoti, no dubbhāsitā, anavajjā ca ananuvajjā ca viññūnan”ti.
segments.snp3.3:2.6: Idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.3:3.1: “Subhāsitaṃ uttamamāhu santo, dhammaṃ bhaṇe nādhammaṃ taṃ dutiyaṃ;
segments.snp3.3:3.3: Piyaṃ bhaṇe nāppiyaṃ taṃ tatiyaṃ, saccaṃ bhaṇe nālikaṃ taṃ catutthan”ti.
segments.snp3.3:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.snp3.3:4.4: Atha kho āyasmā vaṅgīso bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi –
segments.snp3.3:5.3: Pare ca na vihiṃseyya, sā ve vācā subhāsitā.
segments.snp3.3:6.3: Yaṃ anādāya pāpāni, paresaṃ bhāsate piyaṃ.
segments.snp3.3:7.1: “Saccaṃ ve amatā vācā, esa dhammo sanantano;
segments.snp3.3:7.3: Sacce atthe ca dhamme ca, āhu santo patiṭṭhitā.
